name: stri_enc_isutf8
title: Check If a Data Stream Is Possibly in UTF-8

origin.description: Report whether each string's bytes are well-formed UTF-8.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, a raw vector, or a list of raw vectors.

origin.details: The check is exact. An overlong sequence, a surrogate, or a NUL byte is FALSE. An empty byte string is TRUE.
origin.value: A logical vector. One raw vector is one logical value.
origin.example:
x <- stri_enc_isutf8(c("abc", "\u0105"))
cat(paste0("stri_enc_isutf8(c(\"abc\", \"ą\")) returns ", paste(ifelse(x, "TRUE", "FALSE"), collapse = ", "), ".\n"))

translation.description: Report whether each string's bytes are well-formed UTF-8.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, bytes, a list of strings, or a list of byte vectors. None is one missing value for a raw checker and an empty character vector for text.

translation.details: The check is exact. An overlong sequence, a surrogate, or a NUL byte is false. An empty byte string is true.
translation.value: True, False, or NA. A list returns a list.
translation.example:
from stringi.encoding import stri_enc_isutf8
x = stri_enc_isutf8(["abc", "ą"])
print("stri_enc_isutf8([\"abc\", \"ą\"]) returns " + ", ".join("TRUE" if item else "FALSE" for item in x) + ".")
